# Aurora: resolved brand brief

Warm, friendly and welcoming. For community and consumer-facing sites.

This file is the whole Aurora brand in one place, with shared components and Aurora's overrides already merged. Use it to build or review anything for Aurora. Follow it exactly.

## Setup

1. Load the fonts:
   `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:wght@500;700&family=Inter:wght@400;600&display=swap">`
2. Load the variables: `brands/aurora/tokens.css` (copy also at the end of this file).
3. Load the base element styles: `system/base.css`.
4. Copy the CSS of each component you use from the Components section. Use only the CSS variables, never raw colours or font names.

## Icons

Lucide (https://lucide.dev), 2px stroke, rounded caps, coloured with currentColor. 20px inline, 24px standalone.

## Guidelines

> Placeholder brand. Replace with a real brand once scraped.

### Voice

Warm, plain-spoken, encouraging. Short sentences. Speak directly to the reader.

### Principles

- **Welcoming first.** Every page should feel like an invitation, not a form.
- **One clear next step.** Each screen has a single primary action.
- **Room to breathe.** Generous white space; nothing feels crammed.

### Do

- Use primary for the single most important action on a screen.
- Use generous white space; keep body text under 70 characters per line.
- Use Fraunces for headings and Inter for everything else.
- Keep corners rounded using the radius tokens.

### Don't

- Don't use primary and secondary together in the same button group.
- Don't put muted text on coloured backgrounds.
- Don't use more than two font families.
- Don't use sharp (0px) corners.

## Tokens

### color

- `--color-primary`: `#C2410C` — Main brand colour. Buttons, links, key highlights.
- `--color-primary-hover`: `#9A3412` — Hover/pressed state for primary.
- `--color-on-primary`: `#FFFFFF` — Text and icons on primary.
- `--color-secondary`: `#0F766E` — Supporting colour. Secondary buttons, tags.
- `--color-on-secondary`: `#FFFFFF` — Text and icons on secondary.
- `--color-background`: `#FFFBF5` — Page background.
- `--color-surface`: `#FFFFFF` — Cards and panels.
- `--color-text`: `#292524` — Body text. Passes AA on background.
- `--color-muted`: `#78716C` — Captions and secondary text. Use at 16px+ only.
- `--color-border`: `#E7E5E4` — Dividers and card outlines.

### font

- `--font-heading`: `'Fraunces', Georgia, serif` — Headings only.
- `--font-body`: `'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif` — Body and UI text.

### weight

- `--weight-regular`: `400` — Body text.
- `--weight-strong`: `600` — Buttons, labels, emphasis.
- `--weight-heading`: `700` — Headings.

### leading

- `--leading-body`: `1.55` — Line height for body text.
- `--leading-heading`: `1.2` — Line height for headings.

### size

- `--size-small`: `0.8rem` — Small print, tags
- `--size-step-0`: `1rem` — Body text
- `--size-step-1`: `1.25rem` — Lead paragraph / h4
- `--size-step-2`: `1.563rem` — h3
- `--size-step-3`: `1.953rem` — h2
- `--size-step-4`: `2.441rem` — h1

### radius

- `--radius-sm`: `6px` — Inputs, tags
- `--radius-md`: `12px` — Cards, buttons
- `--radius-lg`: `24px` — Hero panels

### space

- `--space-1`: `0.25rem`
- `--space-2`: `0.5rem`
- `--space-3`: `1rem`
- `--space-4`: `1.5rem`
- `--space-5`: `2.5rem`


## Assets

> Placeholder logo. Replace with the real files once scraped.

### Logo

![Aurora logo](assets/logo.svg)

- **File:** `logo.svg` — full-colour logo (sunrise mark + wordmark).
- **Use on:** `--color-background` or `--color-surface` only. Never on primary or photos.
- **Minimum width:** 120px.
- **Clear space:** at least the height of the mark's arc on every side.
- **Don't:** recolour, stretch, or separate the mark from the wordmark.

## Components

### Button

Triggers an action. Primary for the main action on a screen, secondary for the rest. Shared component (`system/components/button.md`).

> Placeholder shared component. Will be replaced by components found when scraping real brands.

#### When to use

- **Primary:** the single most important action on a screen.
- **Secondary:** any other action next to a primary one.

#### Do

- Write the label as a verb: "Join the group", not "Submit".
- Use a `<button>` for actions and an `<a>` styled as a button only for navigation.

#### Don't

- Don't put two primary buttons side by side.
- Don't disable a button without explaining why nearby.

#### Code

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Primary action</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button">Secondary</button>
```

```css
.btn {
  font: var(--weight-strong) var(--size-step-0) / var(--leading-heading) var(--font-body);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-primary {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-on-primary);
}
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); }
.btn-secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-secondary);
}
.btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```

### Callout

A warm, highlighted note that draws attention to one piece of information. Aurora-only (`brands/aurora/components/callout.md`).

Aurora-only component.

#### When to use

- A single tip, reminder or encouragement within a page of body text.
- At most one callout per screen section.

#### Don't

- Don't put a button inside a callout; link to the next step instead.
- Don't use it for errors or warnings.

#### Code

```html
<aside class="callout">
  <p class="callout__title">Good to know</p>
  <p>Bring a friend along — everyone is welcome, no sign-up needed.</p>
</aside>
```

```css
.callout {
  background: var(--color-surface);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--color-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
  max-width: 36rem;
}
.callout p { margin: 0; }
.callout .callout__title {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heading);
  color: var(--color-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-1);
}
```

### Card

Groups related content on a raised surface. Shared component (`system/components/card.md`). Also needs the CSS from: button.

> Placeholder shared component. Will be replaced by components found when scraping real brands.

#### When to use

- A self-contained item in a list or grid: an event, an article, a product.

#### Don't

- Don't nest cards inside cards.
- Don't put more than one primary button in a card.

#### Code

```html
<div class="card">
  <h3>Card title</h3>
  <p>Cards group related content on a surface with a border and a medium radius.</p>
  <button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Learn more</button>
</div>
```

```css
.card {
  background: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-4);
  max-width: 22rem;
}
.card > :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
```

### Input

A single-line text field with a visible label. Shared component (`system/components/input.md`).

> Placeholder shared component. Will be replaced by components found when scraping real brands.

#### When to use

- Short free-text answers: names, emails, search terms.

#### Do

- Always show a visible label above the field. Placeholder text is not a label.

#### Don't

- Don't use placeholder text for instructions the user needs while typing.

#### Code

```html
<label class="field">
  <span class="field__label">Email address</span>
  <input class="input" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
</label>
```

```css
.field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-1); max-width: 22rem; }
.field__label { font-weight: var(--weight-strong); font-size: var(--size-small); }
.input {
  font: inherit;
  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text);
}
.input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
```

### Tag

A small filled label for a category or status. Shared component (`system/components/tag.md`).

> Placeholder shared component. Will be replaced by components found when scraping real brands.

#### When to use

- Short category or status labels next to a title.

#### Don't

- Don't make tags clickable; use a button or link.

#### Code

```html
<span class="tag">Tag</span>
```

```css
.tag {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  color: var(--color-on-secondary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2);
  font-size: var(--size-small);
  font-weight: var(--weight-strong);
}
```

## Base styles (`system/base.css`)

```css
/* Base element styles for any page built with a brand. Load after the brand's tokens.css.
   A brand can replace this file with its own brands/<id>/base.css. Tokens only, no raw colours or fonts. */
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--color-background);
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: var(--size-step-0);
  font-weight: var(--weight-regular);
  line-height: var(--leading-body);
}
h1, h2, h3, h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heading);
  line-height: var(--leading-heading);
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-2);
}
h1 { font-size: var(--size-step-4); }
h2 { font-size: var(--size-step-3); }
h3 { font-size: var(--size-step-2); }
h4 { font-size: var(--size-step-1); }
p { margin: 0 0 var(--space-3); }
a { color: var(--color-primary); }
a:hover { color: var(--color-primary-hover); }
```
